prerequisites.reason: Training methods rely on an objective or error metric to optimize, so understanding loss functions is necessary to understand how learning algorithms improve models.
To learn neural networks in a meaningful way, one must first understand the training procedures and optimization methods used to fit them.
Assessing model performance requires understanding the metrics that quantify prediction error or fit, which is grounded in loss functions.
Unsupervised learning depends on preparing and processing unlabeled data appropriately before patterns can be discovered.
Tangent classifiers build on mathematical ideas from predictive modeling and decision boundary formulation that are more foundationally introduced through regression techniques.
